wargear.name: Artificer armour
wargear.summary: Master-crafted plate worn by proven sergeants and veterans.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Artificer armour has a Save Characteristic of 2+, unless its Save Characteristic is already better.

wargear.name: Refractor field
wargear.summary: A belt-worn field generator that bends incoming fire.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Refractor field has an Invulnerable Save of 5+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Extra armour
wargear.summary: Bolted-on plating, track guards and spall liners.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Extra armour adds 1 to its Hull Points Characteristic.

wargear.name: Company colours
wargear.summary: The company's colours, carried into battle.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Company colours, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics. If the Model carrying the Company colours is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Veteran Sergeant
wargear.summary: A sergeant who has led the squad through a dozen compliances.
wargear.text: A Model upgraded to a Veteran Sergeant adds 1 to its Weapon Skill and Attacks Characteristics.

wargear.name: Iron halo
wargear.summary: A crowned field generator granted for deeds beyond counting.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Iron halo has an Invulnerable Save of 4+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Teleport homer
wargear.summary: A locator beacon keyed to the fleet's teleportarium.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Teleport homer has the Teleport Homer Special Rule.

wargear.name: Auspex array
wargear.summary: A hand-held sensor suite that strips the enemy of cover.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Auspex array has the Auspex Sweep Special Rule.

wargear.name: Medicae stimm-injector
wargear.summary: Combat drugs and coagulants fed straight into the blood.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Medicae stimm-injector has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Relic of the Great Crusade
wargear.summary: A banner scrap, a broken blade, a saint's finger-bone.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Relic of the Great Crusade has the Relic of the Great Crusade Special Rule.

wargear.name: Displacer field
wargear.summary: A short-range warp jump rig that fires when the bearer is struck.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Displacer field has the Displacer Field Special Rule.

wargear.name: Orbital augur-link
wargear.summary: A targeting relay linked to the Legion's orbital augurs.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Orbital augur-link adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

option.text: The Sergeant may take Artificer armour
The Sergeant may be upgraded to a Veteran Sergeant
The Sergeant may take Melta bombs
The unit may carry a Company colours
Legion Armoury: may take up to two relics

rites.name: Pride of the Legion
rites.flavor: The veterans of a hundred compliances take the line themselves.
rites.text: The Legion sends its veterans to the front and trusts them to hold what they take.
benefits: Veteran Tactical, Veteran Assault, Cataphractii Terminator and Tartaros Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (2).
Those units gain First Among Brothers: +1 Leadership and +1 Cool.
limitations: The army must include a Praetor in Terminator armour.
No Recon units and no Inductii.

modifiers.text: Pride of the Legion: Line (2), First Among Brothers.

require.note: Include a Praetor in Terminator armour to lead the veterans.

rites.name: Armoured Spearhead
benefits: Predators, Sicarans and Sicaran Venators may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Every Armour unit gains +1 Ballistic Skill and Iron Column (Outflank, and it may Rush and still fire one weapon on the first turn).
limitations: The army must include at least three Armour units.
No more than two Infantry units in Troops slots.
No Drop Pods, Dreadclaws or Kharybdis.

require.note: The spearhead needs at least three Armour units.

limit.note: At most two Infantry units in Troops slots.

rites.name: Orbital Assault
rites.flavor: The first warning is the scream of retros.
rites.text: The first warning is the scream of retros.
benefits: Drop Pods and Dreadnought Drop Pods gain Drop Assault Vanguard: half of them land on the first turn without a Reserves roll.
Units that disembark from a Drop Pod on the turn it lands gain Hatred (Everything) for that turn.
limitations: At least one Drop Pod is required, and every Infantry unit that can ride in one must start the battle embarked in a Drop Pod.
No Armour, Lord of War or Heavy Transport units other than Drop Pods, and no Rhinos.

modifiers.text: Orbital Assault: Hatred (Everything) on the turn the unit lands from a Drop Pod.
modifiers.condition: on the turn the unit disembarks from a Drop Pod that arrived from Reserves

require.note: Bring at least one Drop Pod.

rites.name: Skyborne Vanguard
rites.flavor: Jump packs lit, the line folds under the falling Legion.
rites.text: Jump packs lit, the line folds under the falling Legion.
benefits: Veteran Assault and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots.
Every Infantry unit with jump packs gains Fast (1) and Death from Above: it may charge on the turn it arrives by Deep Strike.
limitations: No Armour, Heavy Assault or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Skyborne Vanguard: Fast (1), Death from Above.

rites.name: Recon in Force
rites.flavor: Eyes on every road before the main host moves.
rites.text: Eyes on every road before the main host moves.
benefits: Reconnaissance, Scout and Seeker Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Every Recon Infantry unit gains Shrouded (6+) and Forward Positions: a free 6" move before the first turn.
limitations: No Heavy Assault or Lord of War units.
No more than one Heavy Transport.

modifiers.text: Recon in Force: Shrouded (6+), Forward Positions.

rites.name: Siege Breakers
rites.flavor: Every wall falls. The only question is how many brothers it costs.
rites.text: Every wall falls. The only question is how many brothers it costs.
benefits: Breacher and Veteran Breacher Squads gain +1 Toughness.
Vindicators and Arquitor Bombards gain Siege Doctrine: their shots ignore cover from buildings and fortifications, and they gain +1 Front Armour.
limitations: At least two Breacher Squads are required.
No Fast Attack units and no Recon vehicles.

require.note: Bring at least two Breacher Squads.

rites.name: Iron Ancients
rites.flavor: The honoured dead walk ahead of the living.
rites.text: The honoured dead walk ahead of the living.
benefits: Contemptor and Castra Ferrum Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Every Dreadnought gains +1 Weapon Skill and Honoured Ancient: it ignores the Pinned and Suppressed Tactical Statuses and counts as scoring near objectives.
limitations: At least two Dreadnoughts are required.
No Recon or Fast Attack units.

rules.name: First Among Brothers
rules.summary: Veterans who have earned the right to hold the line.
rules.text: All Models in a Unit with this Special Rule add 1 to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics. For the purposes of Mission special rules, a Unit with this Special Rule counts as a Troops Unit.

rules.name: Iron Column
rules.summary: The tanks lead and the infantry follow.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Outflank Special Rule. During the first Battle Turn, a Model with this Special Rule that Rushes may still make a Shooting Attack with one of its Weapons, using its full Ballistic Skill.

rules.name: Drop Assault Vanguard
rules.summary: The first wave lands before the enemy can react.
rules.text: At the start of the first Battle Turn, the Controlling Player chooses half of their Drop Pods with this Special Rule (rounding up); those Drop Pods arrive from Reserves without making a Reserves Roll. The rest arrive normally. Every Model that Disembarks from a Drop Pod with this Special Rule on the turn it arrives has the Hatred (Everything) Special Rule until the end of that turn.

rules.name: Death from Above
rules.summary: Jump packs lit, the line folds under the falling Legion.
rules.text: A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule that arrives from Reserves by Deep Strike may declare a Charge in the same turn. Subtract 2 from the result of that Charge Roll.

rules.name: Forward Positions
rules.summary: Eyes on every road before the main host moves.
rules.text: After both Players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, each Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule may make a Set-up Move of up to 6". It cannot end that move within 9" of any enemy Model.

rules.name: Siege Doctrine
rules.summary: The Legion goes through the walls, not round them.
rules.text: Shooting Attacks made by a Model with this Special Rule ignore any Cover granted by Buildings and Fortifications. A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Front Armour Value.

rules.name: Honoured Ancient
rules.summary: The honoured dead walk ahead of the living.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule can never gain the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Status. A Model with this Special Rule counts as a Scoring Unit while it is within 3" of an Objective.

rules.name: Teleport Homer
rules.text: When a friendly Unit arrives from Reserves by Deep Strike and is set up wholly within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule, it does not Scatter and cannot suffer a Mishap.

rules.name: Auspex Sweep
rules.summary: Nowhere to hide from the augur.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Unit within 18". Until the end of that Shooting Attack, that Unit cannot make Shrouded Damage Mitigation Tests and gains no benefit from Cover against it.

rules.name: Relic of the Great Crusade
rules.summary: Brothers rally to the relics of better days.
rules.text: Friendly Legiones Astartes Units within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule add 1 to their Leadership Characteristic. If this Model is removed as a casualty, every friendly Legiones Astartes Unit that was within 6" of it subtracts 1 from its Leadership Characteristic for the rest of the battle.

rules.name: Displacer Field
rules.summary: The bearer is struck, and then is somewhere else.
rules.text: Once per battle, after a Model with this Special Rule fails a Saving Throw, roll a dice. On a 4+ the Wound is discarded and the Model's Unit is moved up to 6" in any direction, ending at least 1" from any enemy Model. That Unit cannot declare a Charge in the same turn.

armyRules.name: Warrior Brotherhood
armyRules.flavor: The bonds of the Legion hold where other armies break.
benefits: A Legiones Astartes Unit within 6" of another friendly Unit of the same Legion adds 1 to its Leadership Characteristic when it makes a Morale Check.
drawbacks: A Legiones Astartes Unit with no friendly Unit of the same Legion within 12" subtracts 1 from its Leadership Characteristic when it makes a Morale Check.

armyRules.name: Death Before Dishonour
armyRules.flavor: No son of the Legion turns from a challenge.
benefits: When a Model with this Special Rule is reduced to its last Wound in a Challenge, it may immediately make one final set of attacks with its full Attacks Characteristic before it is removed.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule can never decline a Challenge, and cannot be prevented from accepting one.
